now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 114, Agent Keller grows close to Elena, until a Shrike possesses him and she must kill it.

proposed.text: In episode 114, Agent Keller grows close to Elena, until a Shrike parasite infects him and he dies in a burst of crystals. Elena then kills the parasite.

changes.evidence: Episode 114 (S6E4 Code Yellow): the parasite flies into Keller's mouth and fuses with his vascular system; on the way to containment he explodes in a mass of crystalline structures, and Yo-Yo retrieves the knife and stops the parasite. The record leaves out his own death and says 'she must kill it' as if Elena kills him.

now.text: Valkyrie lets Kamala's group into New Asgard, then falls to the horde in the last stand.

changes.evidence: Valkyrie escapes New Asgard (she pilots the ship in episode 4) and is killed in the battle in Paris defending the Infinity Hulk in episode 4. The record's death ('falls to the horde in the last stand') is that battle, so its report BY-019 belongs under the record beside BY-018.

owner_calls.question: Step 1 shows The Lighthouse, but Deke kills Wilfred at Wilfred Malick's Estate in River's End, New York (only the Insight launch is at the Lighthouse). The app has no place for the estate. Keep The Lighthouse or clear it?
options: Keep ['The Lighthouse'] (Insight part of the record)
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom 'Assassination of Wilfred Malick': place = Wilfred Malick's Estate, River's End, New York, July 4, 1976; Wikipedia ep 128: Coulson and May plant explosives in the Lighthouse while Deke and Yo-Yo confront Wilfred, who is killed by Deke.
